A black plastic lever/actuator is visible on the side.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The stamped letters/symbols on the front of the metal guard are indistinct and do not form clear, readable characters. They resemble AI-generated 'fake text' or poorly resolved manufacturing stamps, lacking sharp edges and logical font structure.

The black plastic component lacks fine surface texture or mold lines expected in real plastic injection molding. It appears slightly 'waxy' or overly smooth compared to the detailed metal and translucent plastic, suggesting a minor generation artifact in material rendering.
